content.text: {"answers": [{"question_id": "Q1", "question": "What event or condition triggers the scheduling of a vendor meeting — is it a recurring calendar event, a specific equipment issue, a contract milestone, or something else?", "answer": "The trigger is an improvement request or an equipment issue summary. Once that input exists, the equipment engineer prepares an agenda and issue summary, which then prompts the meeting organizer to schedule the vendor meeting. It is not described as a recurring calendar event or contract milestone."}, {"question_id": "Q2", "question": "Which roles from your organization are expected to attend the vendor meeting, and who has the authority to approve or commit to improvement actions discussed?", "answer": "The equipment engineer and meeting organizer attend from the organization, along with the vendor representative. The manager holds authority to assign action-item owners and due dates, which represents the commitment to improvement actions. The action-item owner is also involved post-meeting for follow-up."}, {"question_id": "Q3", "question": "How is the meeting discussion captured — for example, are written notes taken during the meeting, is the session recorded, or is the summary produced from memory afterward?", "answer": "The meeting organizer records decisions and open questions during the meeting itself as a dedicated activity. The summary is then shared afterward. Whether this is done via written notes, recording, or another method is not specified beyond it being the meeting organizer's responsibility."}, {"question_id": "Q4", "question": "At what point in the process are action items formally identified and assigned to owners — during the meeting itself, or during a separate post-meeting review step?", "answer": "Action items are formally assigned in a separate post-meeting step. After the meeting organizer records decisions and open questions, the manager assigns action-item owners and due dates as a distinct activity before the meeting summary is shared."}, {"question_id": "Q5", "question": "What tool or method is currently used to track action item progress after the meeting, and how are reminders or escalations handled when a deadline is approaching or missed?", "answer": "An action-item tracker is used to monitor progress, supported by a shared document repository. Automation opportunities include automated reminders and status tracking. A missed follow-up deadline is listed as a known exception. The specific escalation path or escalation roles are not specified."}, {"question_id": "Q6", "question": "What does a successfully completed process look like — what specific condition or output signals that this workflow instance is finished?", "answer": "The process is complete when action-item progress has been tracked by the action-item owner, all items are clearly owned with due dates, and the updated improvement proposal is produced.
